instruction: How many casual leaves am I entitled to per year?
output: All full-time employees are entitled to 12 days of casual leave per calendar year. Casual leave cannot be carried forward to the next year and will lapse on December 31st if unused.

instruction: Can I carry forward my casual leave to the next year?
output: No, casual leave cannot be carried forward to the next year. Any unused casual leave will automatically lapse on December 31st of each year. You must utilize all casual leave within the same calendar year.

instruction: How many sick leaves do I get per year?
output: All confirmed employees are granted 10 days of sick leave per year. You must notify your immediate supervisor within the first two hours of your scheduled shift if unable to attend work due to illness. Medical documentation is required for sick leave exceeding three consecutive days.

instruction: Do I need a medical certificate for sick leave?
output: Medical documentation is required for sick leave exceeding three consecutive days. For sick leave of 1-3 days, a self-declaration is sufficient. However, the company reserves the right to request documentation for any sick leave in case of suspected misuse.

instruction: What is the maternity leave policy?
output: Female employees who have worked for at least 80 days in the 12 months preceding the expected date of delivery are entitled to 26 weeks of maternity leave. This can be availed up to 8 weeks before the expected delivery date, with the remaining leave taken post-delivery as per your preference.

instruction: How many days of paternity leave are available?
output: Male employees are entitled to 10 working days of paternity leave upon the birth or adoption of a child. This leave must be availed within 30 days of the child's birth or adoption date. Paternity leave cannot be combined with other types of leave without prior written HR approval.

instruction: What is bereavement leave and how many days can I take?
output: Bereavement leave of up to 5 working days is granted in the event of the death of an immediate family member including spouse, parents, children, or siblings. Additional unpaid leave may be granted at the discretion of the department head based on circumstances and travel requirements.

instruction: How does earned leave work?
output: Earned leave accrues at the rate of one day for every 20 days of active service. You must complete at least one year of continuous service before availing earned leave. It can be accumulated up to a maximum of 45 days and may be encashed upon separation from the company.

instruction: Can I take half-day leave?
output: Yes, half-day leave can be availed for the first half (start of office hours until lunch break) or second half (lunch break until end of office hours). Half-day leave is deducted as 0.5 days from your applicable leave balance.

instruction: What is compensatory off and how do I avail it?
output: Compensatory off is granted when you work on a public holiday or weekly off at your manager's request. It must be availed within 30 days of earning it. You need to submit a request through the HR management system and get approval from your reporting manager.

instruction: What happens if I exhaust all my leave balance?
output: If all leave balances are exhausted, you may apply for leave without pay (LWP) in exceptional circumstances. LWP requires written authorization from both your department head and the HR director. Extended LWP exceeding 30 days may affect your annual increment and performance bonus eligibility.

instruction: How do restricted holidays work?
output: Restricted holidays are optional holidays that you can choose from a predetermined list published at the beginning of each calendar year. Each employee can select up to 2 restricted holidays per year. These must be declared at the start of the year and cannot be changed later without HR approval.

instruction: Is sabbatical leave available?
output: Yes, sabbatical leave of up to 3 months may be granted to employees who have completed 5 or more years of continuous service. It is unpaid leave intended for personal development, higher education, or wellness. Applications must be submitted 3 months in advance and are subject to business requirements and management approval.

instruction: What is the adoption leave policy?
output: The company provides adoption leave of 12 weeks to employees adopting a child below the age of 5 years. This leave is available to both male and female employees and can be taken in one continuous block. You need to submit legal adoption documents to the HR department.

instruction: Can I encash my earned leave?
output: Yes, you can encash earned leave balance exceeding 15 days once per year in December. Encashment is calculated at your basic salary rate for the days encashed. Tax implications of leave encashment are communicated in advance through the payroll advisory.

instruction: What is wellness leave?
output: Employee wellness leave of 2 days per quarter is available for mental health and personal wellness activities. This leave does not require medical documentation and can be used for rest, relaxation, or preventive health activities. Unused wellness leave does not carry forward to the next quarter.

instruction: How do I apply for leave?
output: All leave requests must be submitted through the HR portal. For planned leave, submit your request at least 24 hours in advance. For emergency or sick leave, notify your supervisor within the first two hours of your shift and regularize it through the portal within 2 working days of returning.

instruction: What is the study leave policy?
output: Study leave of up to 10 days per year is available for employees appearing in professional certification examinations. The certification must be relevant to your role and pre-approved by your manager. Exam registration fees are reimbursed upon successful completion of the certification.

instruction: What are the standard working hours?
output: Standard working hours are 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday through Friday, with a one-hour lunch break between 1:00 PM and 2:00 PM. You may choose flexible timing between 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM start time with corresponding end time adjustments, subject to manager approval.

instruction: What is the attendance requirement?
output: All employees are expected to maintain a minimum attendance of 95 percent in each quarter. Attendance is tracked through the biometric system at all office entry points. You must register both arrival and departure times using the biometric device every working day.

instruction: What happens if I come late to work?
output: Late arrivals are recorded when you check in after 10:15 AM without prior approval for flexible timing. Three instances of late arrival in a calendar month will result in the deduction of one casual leave day. Habitual tardiness beyond six instances in a quarter may lead to a formal warning.

instruction: Am I eligible for overtime compensation?
output: Employees working beyond regular shift hours are eligible for overtime compensation if pre-approved by their reporting manager. Overtime rates are 1.5 times the regular hourly rate for weekday overtime and 2 times for weekend or public holiday overtime. Claims must be submitted within 7 days.

instruction: How many public holidays do we get per year?
output: The company observes 10 public holidays per year as per the national and state holiday calendar. The holiday list is published in January each year and is available on the HR portal. If you're required to work on a public holiday, you receive compensatory off.

instruction: What is the flexible working hours policy?
output: Employees may choose a start time between 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM with the corresponding end time adjusted to complete 9 hours (including 1-hour lunch). This flexibility is subject to manager approval and must ensure availability during core hours of 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM.

instruction: Who is eligible for remote work?
output: Employees who have completed at least 6 months of service and received a satisfactory or above performance rating in their last review are eligible for remote work. The arrangement must be formally approved by your department head and HR based on role requirements.

instruction: How many days can I work from home per week?
output: The hybrid work policy allows eligible employees to work remotely for up to 2 days per week. Wednesday is a mandatory in-office day for all employees to facilitate team collaboration. Teams may designate additional mandatory in-office days based on project requirements.

instruction: What are the requirements for working from home?
output: You must have a dedicated workspace with reliable internet connectivity of at least 10 Mbps download speed. You must be available during core business hours (10:00 AM to 4:00 PM) and respond to communications within 30 minutes during these hours. WFH requests must be submitted 24 hours in advance.

instruction: Is there a home office allowance?
output: Yes, the company provides a one-time home office setup allowance of INR 15,000 for employees approved for regular remote work arrangements. This is intended to help you set up an ergonomic workspace at home with necessary equipment.

instruction: Can my remote work privileges be revoked?
output: Yes, remote work privileges may be revoked if you fail to maintain expected productivity levels, miss meetings without notice, or are consistently unreachable during core hours. HR will provide written notice of any revocation with a 7-day transition period to return to office.

instruction: Do I need to use VPN when working remotely?
output: Yes, remote work security requires you to use only company-approved VPN connections when accessing corporate systems. Personal devices must not be used for official work without MDM enrollment. You must also ensure that family members do not have access to your work screens.

instruction: What happens during the onboarding process?
output: All new employees undergo a structured onboarding program during their first 30 days. It includes orientation sessions, department introductions, system access setup, policy documentation review, and assignment of a buddy mentor. You'll also receive a welcome kit with company merchandise and guides.

instruction: What mandatory training do I need to complete as a new hire?
output: New hires must complete all mandatory compliance training modules within their first week. This includes training on data security, anti-harassment policy, workplace safety, code of conduct, and information security protocols. Completion is tracked through the Learning Management System.

instruction: What is the probation period?
output: The probation period for all new employees is 6 months from the date of joining. During this period, you are evaluated on performance, cultural fit, and adherence to company policies. Probation may be extended by up to 3 months if performance is below expectations.

instruction: What happens after I complete probation?
output: Upon successful probation completion, you receive a confirmation letter and become eligible for all benefits including health insurance, performance bonuses, and earned leave accrual. Your reporting manager must submit a probation assessment at least 15 days before your probation end date.

instruction: What is the buddy program for new employees?
output: The onboarding buddy program pairs new employees with experienced colleagues for their first 90 days. Your buddy helps with cultural integration, process navigation, relationship building, and practical questions. Buddy participation is voluntary and recognized as a development activity.

instruction: When will I get my laptop and system access?
output: IT setup including laptop configuration, email activation, and system access is completed within your first day of joining. Your new employee orientation includes all necessary setup instructions. If you face any issues, contact the IT helpdesk for immediate support.

instruction: When is salary processed each month?
output: Salary is processed on the last working day of each month for all confirmed employees. If you join after the 15th of a month, your first salary will be credited on the last working day of the following month. Salary is directly credited to your registered bank account.

instruction: What are the components of my salary structure?
output: Your salary structure includes basic salary (40% of CTC), house rent allowance (50% of basic for metro cities, 40% for non-metro), special allowance, conveyance allowance, and other applicable components. The detailed breakup is provided in your offer letter and available on the HR portal.

instruction: When should I submit investment declarations for tax?
output: Investment declarations must be submitted at the beginning of each financial year in April. Proof of investments must be submitted by January 31st each year to avoid higher tax deductions in the remaining months. The payroll team provides guidance on eligible deductions.

instruction: How is the annual performance bonus calculated?
output: The annual performance bonus is calculated based on your individual performance rating and company performance. Bonus payouts typically range from 0 to 20 percent of annual CTC depending on rating band. The bonus cycle runs April to March with payouts in June-July.

instruction: When do annual increments take effect?
output: Annual increments are effective from April 1st each year based on your performance review rating. The percentage varies by rating: Exceptional (15-20%), Exceeds Expectations (10-14%), Meets Expectations (7-9%), Needs Improvement (0-3%). Increments are reflected in the April salary.

instruction: How do I report a payroll discrepancy?
output: If you notice a discrepancy in your salary, submit a query through the HR portal or contact the payroll team directly. The payroll team investigates and responds within 10 working days. If unresolved, you can escalate to the HR director for final resolution.

instruction: What deductions are made from my salary?
output: Standard deductions include income tax (TDS as per applicable tax slabs), Employee Provident Fund (12% of basic), professional tax (as per state regulations), and any voluntary deductions you've opted for such as additional PF contribution or insurance premiums.

instruction: How do I get approval for business travel?
output: All business travel must be pre-approved by your reporting manager through the travel management system. Submit requests at least 5 working days before domestic travel and 15 days for international travel. The request should include travel purpose, dates, and estimated costs.

instruction: What is the travel policy for domestic air travel?
output: Domestic air travel is permitted for distances exceeding 500 kilometers. For distances between 200-500 km, AC 2-tier train travel is standard. For under 200 km, company-arranged cab or personal vehicle with mileage reimbursement at INR 12 per kilometer is applicable.

instruction: What is the hotel accommodation limit for business travel?
output: Hotel accommodation is reimbursed up to INR 5,000 per night for tier-1 cities and INR 3,500 per night for other locations. You must book through the company's approved travel portal to avail corporate rates. Exceptions require prior written approval from your department head.

instruction: What is the daily allowance during travel?
output: Daily allowance for food and incidental expenses is INR 1,500 for domestic travel in tier-1 cities and INR 1,000 for other domestic locations. International daily allowance varies by country and is published in the travel policy appendix updated annually.

instruction: How long do I have to submit travel expense claims?
output: All travel expense claims must be submitted within 10 working days of returning from the trip. Claims must include original receipts, boarding passes, hotel invoices, and supporting documentation. Late submissions beyond 30 days may result in forfeiture of the reimbursement claim.

instruction: What is the medical reimbursement limit?
output: Medical reimbursement of up to INR 15,000 per year is available for expenses not covered by group health insurance. Claims must be supported by original prescriptions, medical bills, and pharmacy receipts. Reimbursement is processed within 15 working days of submission.

instruction: Is there internet reimbursement for WFH?
output: Yes, internet and telephone reimbursement of up to INR 1,500 per month is available for employees with approved remote work arrangements. Submit your monthly claim along with the utility bill copy through the expense portal.

instruction: What is the professional development reimbursement?
output: Professional development reimbursement of up to INR 50,000 per year is available for job-related certifications, courses, and conferences. Prior approval from your manager and HR is required before enrollment. Submit completion certificates and payment receipts for reimbursement.

instruction: How does the performance review process work?
output: The performance management cycle runs annually from April to March. It consists of goal setting in April, a mid-year review in October, and the annual performance review in March. You collaborate with your manager on setting SMART goals aligned with team and organizational objectives.

instruction: What rating scale is used for performance reviews?
output: Performance reviews use a 5-point rating scale: Outstanding, Exceeds Expectations, Meets Expectations, Needs Improvement, and Unsatisfactory. The review includes self-assessment, manager assessment, peer feedback, and a calibration session at the department level.

instruction: What happens if I get a low performance rating?
output: If you receive a Needs Improvement or Unsatisfactory rating, a Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) is initiated. The PIP duration is typically 60 to 90 days with clearly defined goals and metrics. Failure to meet PIP objectives may result in further action including termination.

instruction: How often should I have one-on-one meetings with my manager?
output: Managers are expected to conduct at least two formal one-on-one sessions per month with each team member. These sessions provide an opportunity for continuous feedback on ongoing work, career discussions, and addressing any concerns or blockers you may have.

instruction: What are the criteria for promotion?
output: Promotion decisions are made annually during the April review cycle based on sustained performance, demonstrated competencies at the next level, and availability of positions. You must have completed at least 18 months in your current role to be considered unless in exceptional circumstances.

instruction: How does the performance calibration work?
output: Calibration sessions are facilitated by HR business partners and include all managers within a business unit. Rating distributions are reviewed against expected guidelines to prevent inflation or deflation. This ensures consistency and fairness in ratings across teams and departments.

instruction: What health insurance coverage do I get?
output: Group health insurance covers you and your dependents (spouse, up to two children, and dependent parents) with a sum insured of INR 5,00,000 per family per year. You can opt for additional top-up at your own cost. Pre-existing disease coverage begins after a 30-day waiting period.

instruction: Is dental and vision care covered?
output: Yes, dental and vision care are included in the group health insurance. Dental coverage includes annual check-ups, fillings, and basic procedures up to INR 20,000. Vision coverage includes annual eye examinations and reimbursement for corrective lenses up to INR 5,000 per year.

instruction: What is the Employee Assistance Program?
output: The EAP provides confidential counseling services for personal and work-related issues. You can access up to 6 free counseling sessions per year through our EAP partner. Services include mental health support, financial counseling, legal guidance, and stress management.

instruction: What life insurance coverage is provided?
output: Life insurance coverage of 3 times your annual basic salary is provided at no cost to you. Additional voluntary life insurance can be purchased at group rates. Make sure to keep your nominee details updated in the HR system and review them annually.

instruction: How does the Provident Fund work?
output: The company contributes 12% of your basic salary to the Employee Provident Fund as mandated by law. You also contribute 12% from your basic salary. You may opt for higher voluntary contribution up to 100% of basic salary subject to applicable tax rules.

instruction: Am I eligible for gratuity?
output: Gratuity is payable to employees who have completed 5 or more years of continuous service. The amount is calculated as 15 days of last drawn salary for each completed year of service. The maximum gratuity payable is INR 20,00,000 as per current regulations.

instruction: Is there a gym membership benefit?
output: Yes, gym and fitness center membership reimbursement of up to INR 2,500 per month is available. Alternatively, you can use the in-office gym facility available from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM on working days. Annual health check-ups are provided free for employees above 30 years.

instruction: What meal benefits are provided?
output: The company provides a subsidized cafeteria with breakfast, lunch, and evening snacks. Meal coupons worth INR 2,200 per month are available for the tax-exempt food benefit. Employees with dietary restrictions can request special meal accommodations through facility management.

instruction: Are there any childcare benefits?
output: Yes, the company provides childcare support through partnerships with daycare centers near office locations. Employees with children aged 6 months to 6 years can avail subsidized daycare services. A creche facility is available at headquarters for children up to 2 years.

instruction: What is the tuition reimbursement policy?
output: Tuition reimbursement of up to INR 2,00,000 per year is available for job-related degree programs. You must have completed 2 years of service and received manager approval before enrollment. A 2-year service bond post-completion is required to retain the benefit.

instruction: Is there an employee stock option plan?
output: Employee stock option plans are available to employees at manager level and above based on performance and tenure. ESOP vesting follows a 4-year schedule with a 1-year cliff. Detailed terms are provided in your individual ESOP grant letter.

instruction: What is the employee referral bonus?
output: The employee referral program offers bonuses ranging from INR 25,000 to INR 1,00,000 depending on position level. The bonus is paid in two installments: 50% after joining and 50% after the referred employee completes 6 months of service.

instruction: What is the company's anti-harassment policy?
output: The company strictly prohibits any form of workplace harassment including sexual harassment, bullying, discrimination, and intimidation. All employees must complete mandatory anti-harassment training annually. Violations result in immediate disciplinary action which may include termination.

instruction: How do I report workplace harassment?
output: Complaints can be filed through the confidential ICC portal, email to the Internal Complaints Committee, or in person. The ICC completes investigations within 90 days of receiving a complaint. Your identity is kept confidential throughout the process.

instruction: What is the whistleblower policy?
output: Whistleblower protection is provided to employees who report genuine concerns about unethical behavior, fraud, or policy violations. Reports can be made anonymously through the ethics hotline. The company guarantees protection from retaliation for good-faith reports.

instruction: What is the policy on gifts from vendors?
output: Gifts and entertainment from vendors or clients exceeding INR 2,000 in value must be declared to the compliance team. Employees are prohibited from accepting cash gifts under any circumstances. Failure to comply may result in disciplinary action.

instruction: What is the clean desk policy?
output: All employees must secure sensitive documents before leaving their workstation. Confidential papers must be stored in locked drawers and not left visible overnight. Printed documents with sensitive information must be disposed of using designated shredding bins.

instruction: What are the information security requirements?
output: You must use strong passwords, enable two-factor authentication, never share credentials, lock workstations when unattended, and report suspected security breaches immediately. Company data must be handled according to its classification level (Public, Internal, Confidential, Restricted).

instruction: Can I do freelance work while employed here?
output: Employees must not engage in moonlighting or secondary employment without prior written approval from HR. Approval may be granted for activities that don't conflict with your role, don't use company resources, and don't create a conflict of interest.

instruction: What is the social media policy?
output: Social media usage during work hours should be limited to professional purposes. You must not share confidential company information, client details, or internal communications on any platform. The policy applies to both personal and professional accounts when discussing work-related matters.

instruction: What are the annual compliance certifications?
output: Annual compliance certifications on code of conduct, information security, anti-harassment, data privacy, and anti-corruption must be completed by all employees by March 31st each year. Non-completion may affect eligibility for annual increments and bonuses.

instruction: What is the policy on conflicts of interest?
output: Employees must avoid conflicts of interest and disclose any potential conflicts to their reporting manager and compliance team promptly. Annual declarations of outside interests, investments in competing companies, and family members at competitors are mandatory.

instruction: What is the notice period for resignation?
output: The notice period is 60 days for roles up to senior manager level and 90 days for director level and above. Notice period must be served in full unless buyout is approved by the department head and HR. Buyout is calculated at your daily gross salary rate.

instruction: How do I submit my resignation?
output: Submit your resignation in writing through the HR portal. Your last working day is determined by adding the notice period to the resignation acceptance date. An exit interview is conducted by HR during your final week of employment.

instruction: When will I receive my full and final settlement?
output: Full and final settlement is processed within 45 days of your last working day. It includes pending salary, earned leave encashment, gratuity if applicable, reimbursement claims, and deductions for notice period shortfall or asset recovery. Complete the exit clearance checklist to initiate the process.

instruction: What company assets do I need to return?
output: All company assets including laptop, ID card, access cards, mobile phone, and any other equipment must be returned on or before your last working day. Failure to return assets will result in their cost being deducted from your full and final settlement amount.

instruction: Is knowledge transfer mandatory during notice period?
output: Yes, knowledge transfer is mandatory during the notice period. You must document your ongoing projects, processes, and key contacts. Your reporting manager ensures adequate knowledge transfer and sign-off before your last working day.

instruction: Is there a non-compete clause?
output: Non-compete agreements remain in effect for 12 months after separation for employees at manager level and above. This restricts employment with direct competitors within the same geographic market. Violations may result in legal action as specified in the employment agreement.

instruction: Can I get an experience letter?
output: Separation certificate and experience letter are issued within 7 working days of your last working day upon completion of exit formalities. Service letters for specific purposes like loan applications or visa processing can be requested through the HR portal with 3 working days processing time.

instruction: What should I do in case of a medical emergency at work?
output: Contact the front desk at extension 100 or call the designated emergency number. First aid kits are available on every floor and trained first aid responders are identified by green badges. All incidents requiring medical attention must be reported to HR within 24 hours.

instruction: How often are fire drills conducted?
output: Fire drills are conducted quarterly and all employees must participate in the evacuation procedure. You should be familiar with evacuation routes, assembly points, and the emergency contact tree for your location. The safety committee oversees drill execution and effectiveness.

instruction: How do I report a safety hazard?
output: Report any safety hazards, near-miss incidents, or unsafe conditions immediately to the facility management team. You can also report through the workplace incident reporting system on the intranet. Reports are investigated within 24 hours of submission with corrective actions tracked to completion.

instruction: What is the workplace violence policy?
output: The company maintains a zero-tolerance policy for workplace violence including physical aggression, verbal threats, and intimidating behavior. If you witness or experience violence, report immediately to security and HR. Perpetrators face immediate suspension pending investigation.

instruction: What is the annual learning budget?
output: The company allocates INR 10,000 per employee per year for individual development activities. This can be used for books, online courses, workshop registrations, and professional memberships. Additionally, you have access to LinkedIn Learning, Coursera, and Udemy Business at no cost.

instruction: How do I apply for a conference or training program?
output: Submit a conference attendance request through the learning portal with a business justification and expected learning outcomes. Prior approval from your manager is required. Post-attendance, you must share knowledge with your team through a presentation or written summary.

instruction: Is there a mentorship program?
output: Yes, mentorship programs are available for all employees seeking career growth guidance. Senior leaders volunteer as mentors matched with mentees based on career interests and development goals. The formal mentorship cycle runs for 6 months with monthly structured meetings.

instruction: How does the internal job posting work?
output: Internal job postings are published on the company intranet for all open positions. Employees who have completed at least 12 months in their current role may apply for internal transfers. Your current manager is notified after you clear the initial screening stage.

instruction: What is the job rotation program?
output: The job rotation program allows employees to experience different roles within the organization for 3 to 6 months. It develops versatile employees, builds cross-functional understanding, and aids career exploration. You return to your original role with enhanced skills and broader perspective.

instruction: How many hours of learning are expected annually?
output: Employees are expected to complete a minimum of 40 hours of learning annually. Learning achievements are visible on your internal talent profile. The company provides access to an online library with over 10,000 courses across technical, business, and leadership domains.

instruction: What is the company's diversity and inclusion policy?
output: The company maintains a zero-tolerance policy for discrimination based on gender, religion, caste, race, age, disability, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. Equal opportunities are provided in recruitment, promotion, training, and all aspects of employment.

instruction: What employee resource groups are available?
output: Current ERGs include Women in Technology, LGBTQ+ Alliance, Working Parents Network, and Cultural Diversity Forum. ERG participation is voluntary and does not affect performance evaluations. These groups focus on building community and advancing inclusive workplace practices.

instruction: What accommodations are available for employees with disabilities?
output: Reasonable accommodations include modified workstations, assistive technology, flexible schedules, or modified job duties. Accommodation requests are handled confidentially by the HR accessibility coordinator. Physical, digital, and communication accessibility features are maintained in all facilities.

instruction: How does the company ensure pay equity?
output: Annual compensation audits compare salaries across gender, age, tenure, and role parameters. Statistically significant pay gaps are investigated and corrected. The pay equity report is shared with the board compensation committee annually. All recruitment panels must include diverse representation.

instruction: How do I update my personal information?
output: Personal data updates including address changes, emergency contact modifications, and banking details must be submitted through the HR self-service portal. Changes to critical information like bank accounts require additional HR verification. Updates are effective from the next payroll cycle.

instruction: How do I raise a grievance?
output: Grievances can be filed through the HR portal, direct conversation with HR business partners, or through the anonymous feedback system. All grievances are acknowledged within 48 hours and resolved within 15 working days. You can escalate through the formal escalation matrix if needed.

instruction: What is the dress code policy?
output: Business casual attire is the standard for regular working days. Client-facing meetings and formal events require business formal attire. Casual Fridays allow relaxed attire excluding shorts, flip-flops, and sleeveless tops. Exemptions for religious or medical reasons are handled by HR.

instruction: How does the parking facility work?
output: Parking is available on a first-come-first-served basis for employees using personal vehicles. Reserved spots are allocated to employees with mobility challenges and senior leadership. Two-wheeler parking is in the designated area with company-provided helmet locks.

instruction: Can I get a salary advance for emergencies?
output: Yes, interest-free salary advances for medical emergencies or natural disasters are available. Advances up to one month's gross salary are provided with repayment over 6 months through salary deduction. Applications require supporting documentation and are processed within 3 working days.

instruction: How does the employee loan facility work?
output: Employee loans are available for emergencies including medical emergencies, natural disasters, and critical home repairs. Loan amounts up to 2 months' gross salary are available at zero interest, repayable over 12 months through salary deduction. Applications are reviewed within 5 working days.

instruction: What transportation is provided for late shifts?
output: Transportation facilities are provided for employees working late shifts ending after 8:00 PM. Female employees are provided cab facilities for shifts ending after 7:00 PM regardless of location. All cab services are GPS-tracked for safety purposes.

instruction: How do I request an ergonomic assessment?
output: Submit a request through the facility management portal if you're experiencing discomfort at your workstation. The team provides ergonomic accessories including standing desk converters, footrests, wrist rests, and document holders. Recommendations are implemented within 10 working days.

instruction: What is the meeting-free hours policy?
output: Wednesday afternoons from 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM are designated as protected focus time. No meetings should be scheduled during this period to allow uninterrupted deep work. Exceptions require department head approval for urgent client or business-critical matters only.

instruction: How do I book a conference room?
output: Conference rooms are booked through the facility management portal. Meetings should not exceed the booked duration to respect other teams' schedules. Leave rooms clean and return all equipment including projectors and video conferencing systems to standby mode after use.

instruction: What is the company library and learning platform access?
output: The company library provides professional books and journals. You can borrow up to 3 books for 14 days. Digital platforms including LinkedIn Learning, Coursera, and Udemy Business are available at no cost. Access these through the learning portal using your company credentials.

instruction: How does the relocation assistance work?
output: Employees transferred to a different city receive relocation benefits including moving expenses up to INR 1,00,000, temporary accommodation for 30 days, and a settling-in allowance of INR 50,000. Family relocation benefits are extended to employees at manager level and above.

instruction: What is the employee hardship fund?
output: The employee hardship fund is available for employees facing unforeseen financial difficulties due to medical emergencies, natural disasters, or family crises. It is managed by a committee of senior HR leaders. Grants from the fund do not require repayment.

instruction: How do I get verification of my employment for a loan?
output: Employment verification is provided through an authorized third-party verification partner. Standard verification includes employment dates, designation, and compensation with your written consent. Service letters for loan applications can be requested through the HR portal with 3 working days processing time.

instruction: What happens during organizational restructuring?
output: The restructuring protocol ensures transparent communication and fair treatment. Affected employees receive outplacement support, extended notice periods, and enhanced severance packages. Redeployment within the organization is explored before any separation decisions are made.

instruction: Can I apply for internal transfers?
output: Yes, internal job postings are published on the company intranet. You must have completed at least 12 months in your current role to apply. The talent marketplace platform also allows you to find project assignments, mentoring relationships, and learning experiences internally.

instruction: What is the policy on AI tools in the workplace?
output: AI tools must be approved by the IT security team before use. You must not input confidential or personal data into external AI systems without proper data protection safeguards. The company maintains formal policies regarding employee use of artificial intelligence tools.

instruction: How does the flexible benefits plan work?
output: Flexible benefit plans allow you to structure your compensation within the approved CTC framework. You can allocate amounts across food coupons, fuel allowance, telephone reimbursement, and professional development based on your individual needs. Changes are made during the annual enrollment window.

instruction: What CSR activities can I participate in?
output: The company's CSR programs focus on education, environmental sustainability, and community development. You are granted 2 paid volunteering days per year for company-organized CSR activities. Activities include teaching, environmental drives, and community health camps organized monthly.

instruction: How does the reward and recognition platform work?
output: The platform allows peer-to-peer recognition through digital badges and points. Accumulated points can be redeemed for gift cards, merchandise, or charitable donations. Spot awards of INR 5,000 to INR 25,000 can be nominated by any manager for exceptional contributions.

instruction: What is the company's data privacy policy for employees?
output: Personal information is collected only for legitimate employment purposes and stored securely with restricted access. You can request access to your personal data or corrections through the HR portal. Employee data privacy is maintained in accordance with applicable data protection regulations.

instruction: How do I request a shift change?
output: Shift change requests should be discussed with your reporting manager first and then submitted through the HR portal. Changes are subject to business requirements and team coverage needs. Night shift employees receive an additional 15% allowance and rotational shift employees get 10% premium.

instruction: What is the background verification process for new hires?
output: Background verification includes education verification, employment history check, criminal record check, and reference checks for all new hires. Offers are contingent upon successful completion. Discrepancies found during verification may result in offer withdrawal or termination.

instruction: How does the company handle workplace investigations?
output: Investigations are conducted by trained HR investigators or external parties for senior-level matters. All parties have the right to present their case. The investigation report is shared only with relevant decision-makers. The company ensures fair and thorough investigation of all reported misconduct.

instruction: What is the policy on workplace romantic relationships?
output: Disclosure is required when a reporting relationship exists between the parties in a romantic relationship. The company will arrange alternative reporting structures to eliminate conflicts of interest. Non-disclosure of such relationships may be treated as a policy violation.

instruction: How do annual health check-ups work?
output: Annual health check-up packages are provided free of cost to all employees above 30 years of age. The company also organizes flu vaccination drives at all office locations in October-November at no cost. Pre-employment health screening is conducted for all new hires.

instruction: What is the company's environmental sustainability policy?
output: The company encourages paperless operations, energy conservation, and waste reduction. Sustainability goals include reducing carbon emissions by 50% by 2030, zero waste to landfill, and 100% renewable energy. Quarterly sustainability reports are published and employee participation is tracked.

instruction: How do I access the employee discount program?
output: The employee discount program covers retail, travel, entertainment, and wellness services through corporate partnerships. Access the discount portal through the company intranet. It's updated monthly with new offerings and seasonal promotions with discounts ranging from 10 to 40 percent.

instruction: What is the on-call policy and compensation?
output: Employees on standby for emergency support receive on-call allowance of INR 500 per weekday night and INR 1,000 per weekend day. Actual call-out time is compensated at overtime rates in addition to the standby allowance. The policy covers employees required to be available outside regular hours.

instruction: How does the phased retirement option work?
output: Phased retirement allows gradual reduction in work hours over 12 to 24 months while maintaining prorated benefits. This arrangement supports knowledge transfer and transition planning. It is available to employees approaching retirement age who wish to transition gradually.

instruction: What support is available for employees experiencing domestic violence?
output: The company provides comprehensive support including confidential counseling, flexible work arrangements, financial assistance for relocation, and legal guidance. The HR team works sensitively with affected employees to ensure safety and continued employment. All information is handled with strict confidentiality.

instruction: How do I participate in the innovation program?
output: Submit ideas through the innovation portal for evaluation by the innovation committee. The company also operates an innovation lab where teams can prototype solutions through a quarterly application process. Successful innovations receive funding, recognition awards, and patent filing support.

instruction: What is the company's policy on political activity?
output: Employees may participate in political activities as private citizens outside work hours. Company name, resources, or position must not be used for political purposes. Political discussions in the workplace should be respectful and non-disruptive. The company maintains neutrality on political matters.

instruction: How does the alumni network work?
output: The alumni network maintains connections with former employees through online communities, annual reunion events, and networking opportunities. Alumni receive priority consideration for rehiring and can participate in mentoring programs. The alumni portal provides access to industry updates and opportunities.

instruction: What is the secondment program?
output: The secondment program allows employees to work in partner organizations, industry bodies, or non-profit entities for 3 to 12 months. Secondments develop external perspective and build broader capabilities. You remain on company payroll during the secondment period.

instruction: How do I get language learning support?
output: Language courses are available through online platforms and in-person classes. Employees working with international teams receive priority access. Language learning support is provided for those requiring proficiency in additional languages for their role. Contact the L&D team to enroll.

instruction: What is the talent marketplace platform?
output: The talent marketplace allows you to find internal opportunities including full-time positions, project assignments, mentoring relationships, and learning experiences. It uses skills-based matching to recommend relevant opportunities. Managers can also post project needs to source internal talent.

instruction: How does the employee wellness score work?
output: The wellness score tracks physical health, mental health, financial wellness, and social connection metrics. Aggregate scores inform wellness program design. Individual scores are private and shared only with you. Participate in wellness challenges each quarter to improve your score.

instruction: What is the company's approach to workload management?
output: Managers conduct quarterly workload reviews with each team member. Sustained overwork patterns must be addressed through resource reallocation, priority adjustment, or hiring. Employee burnout indicators are monitored through engagement surveys and wellness check-ins. Report concerns to your manager or HR.

instruction: How do I file an expense report?
output: Submit expense reports through the expense management portal with original receipts and documentation. All expenses must be reasonable and necessary for business purposes. Reports exceeding INR 50,000 require additional finance controller approval. Claims are processed within 15 working days.

instruction: What happens during a business continuity event?
output: The business continuity plan outlines procedures for maintaining operations during disruptions. All critical roles have backup personnel trained to assume responsibilities. Communication is managed through the emergency notification system supporting SMS, email, and app push notifications simultaneously.

instruction: How do I get international travel approval?
output: Submit your request through the travel management system at least 15 days before the intended travel date. Register your travel with the corporate security team. Obtain necessary visas and travel insurance through the company travel desk. The company covers all visa fees and vaccination costs.

instruction: What is the company's approach to continuous feedback?
output: Continuous feedback is encouraged through one-on-one meetings, the peer recognition platform, and formal check-ins. Managers should provide real-time feedback on ongoing work. Pulse surveys are conducted every 6 weeks. The company operates an always-on feedback channel for employee input.

instruction: How do spot awards work?
output: Spot awards of INR 5,000 to INR 25,000 recognize exceptional contributions immediately. Any manager can nominate a team member with department head approval. Recognition is public and announced in team meetings and on the company recognition platform. There's no limit to how many you can receive.

instruction: What support is available for new managers?
output: New managers must complete people management training within 90 days covering performance management, feedback delivery, conflict resolution, and team development. The new manager assimilation process includes a facilitated team session within 30 days. Executive coaching is available for senior hires.

instruction: How does the company handle data classification?
output: Information is categorized into four levels: Public, Internal, Confidential, and Restricted. Access to each level is granted based on role requirements and approved by data owners. You must handle information according to its classification at all times. Annual training on data protection is mandatory.

instruction: What are the vendor management requirements?
output: All third-party service providers must comply with the company's data security and ethical standards. Vendors handling employee or customer data must sign data processing agreements. Annual vendor audits ensure compliance. You must not make verbal commitments without proper purchase order authorization.

instruction: How do I request a technology equipment upgrade?
output: The technology refresh policy provides new laptops every 3 years and monitors every 5 years. If your equipment significantly impacts productivity, request early replacement through the IT portal. Returned equipment is refurbished for internal use or recycled through certified e-waste processors.

instruction: What is the company's hiring freeze protocol?
output: During a hiring freeze, only critical replacement hiring is permitted with CEO approval. Internal transfers and role changes may continue as they don't increase headcount. The freeze is activated during periods of business uncertainty or financial constraints and communicated through official channels.

instruction: How do I participate in cross-functional projects?
output: You can volunteer for cross-functional projects for up to 20% of your work time with manager approval. The talent marketplace platform helps you find opportunities. Such participation is considered positively during performance reviews and builds broader organizational knowledge.

instruction: What is the process for reporting ethics violations?
output: Report concerns through the business ethics helpline (24/7, managed by an independent third party), the confidential portal, or directly to the compliance team. Reports can be made anonymously. All reports are investigated confidentially and the no-retaliation policy protects good-faith reporters.

instruction: How are employee surveys conducted?
output: The company uses a continuous listening strategy: annual engagement surveys, quarterly pulse checks, and monthly employee pulse surveys every 6 weeks. All responses are anonymous. Results are shared with managers within one week. Action plans must be communicated to teams within 30 days.

instruction: What financial wellness support is available?
output: The financial wellness program provides financial planning tools, retirement calculators, tax advisory sessions, and debt management guidance. Monthly financial literacy webinars cover budgeting to investment strategies. One-on-one counseling sessions are available quarterly. Tax planning workshops run in January-February.

instruction: How do I apply for the brand ambassador program?
output: The brand ambassador program trains selected employees to represent the company at external events, career fairs, and social media. Ambassadors receive communication training and company talking points. Participation is recognized in performance reviews. Apply through the internal communications team.

instruction: What is the company's approach to succession planning?
output: The company identifies two potential successors for every critical leadership role. Development plans are created including stretch assignments, executive coaching, and leadership exposure. Plans are reviewed bi-annually by the talent management committee. High-potential employees are identified through annual talent reviews.

instruction: How does the company ensure recruitment fairness?
output: All recruitment panels must include diverse representation to minimize unconscious bias. Panelists complete bias awareness training before evaluating candidates. Positions are advertised internally before external hiring. Selection is based on qualifications, experience, skills, and cultural fit without discrimination.

instruction: What is the role clarity exercise?
output: Annual role clarity exercises require employees and managers to align on role expectations, key deliverables, decision-making authority, and collaboration requirements. These are living documents updated when significant changes occur. Clear role definition prevents confusion and ensures accountability.

instruction: How does the coaching pool work?
output: The internal coaching pool consists of certified coaches from various business functions. Request coaching for specific developmental needs through the learning portal. Engagements typically last 6 months with bi-weekly sessions focused on defined goals. It's available to employees at all levels.

instruction: What is the company's approach to change management?
output: Formal change management protocols exist for all significant organizational changes. Affected employees are consulted during planning and provided transition support. Communication is transparent and timely. Change readiness assessments are conducted before implementation to ensure smooth transitions.

instruction: How do I request workplace accommodations?
output: Submit accommodation requests to the HR accessibility coordinator. Accommodations may include modified workstations, assistive technology, flexible schedules, or modified job duties. Requests are handled confidentially. The company conducts annual workplace accessibility audits to ensure compliance with standards.

instruction: What is the time tracking requirement?
output: Log your time accurately on a daily basis against assigned projects and activities. The weekly submission deadline is Monday noon for the previous week. Time tracking is used for project cost allocation, client billing, and resource planning. Accurate logging ensures proper project management.

instruction: How does the performance improvement plan process work?
output: A PIP is initiated for employees with Needs Improvement or Unsatisfactory ratings. Duration is typically 60-90 days with clearly defined goals and metrics. Regular check-ins occur throughout the PIP period. Failure to meet objectives may result in further action including role change or termination.

instruction: What is the company's anti-bribery policy?
output: The company prohibits all forms of bribery including facilitation payments. Report any solicitation of bribes to the compliance team immediately. Annual anti-corruption training is mandatory, especially for client-facing and procurement roles. Violations result in severe disciplinary action including termination.

instruction: How do I register for voluntary benefits?
output: Voluntary benefits including critical illness insurance, accident cover top-up, spouse career support, and elder care assistance are available at group rates. Enrollment occurs during the annual benefits enrollment window. Changes are effective from the following month. Details are on the benefits portal.

instruction: What is the leave year cycle?
output: The leave year follows the calendar year from January 1st to December 31st. Leave balances are reset at the beginning of each year. Earned leave is the only type that can be carried forward subject to the maximum accumulation limit of 45 days.

instruction: Can I take leave during probation?
output: During probation, you are entitled to casual leave and sick leave on a pro-rata basis. Earned leave does not accrue during the probation period. Other benefits like health insurance may also have limited availability until probation confirmation.

instruction: What is the process for emergency leave?
output: For emergency leave, notify your immediate supervisor as soon as possible by phone or message. Regularize the leave through the HR portal within 2 working days of your return. Emergency leave is typically deducted from casual leave or earned leave balance.

instruction: Can I combine different types of leave?
output: Yes, you can combine different types of leave with manager approval. For example, you can combine earned leave with public holidays or weekends. However, paternity leave cannot be combined with other leave types without prior written HR approval.

instruction: What is the maximum leave I can take at one time?
output: There is no strict maximum for a single leave request, but extended leave beyond 10 consecutive days requires department head approval. Leave beyond 30 days requires HR director approval. Extended absence may require work redistribution and interim coverage arrangements.

instruction: How do I check my leave balance?
output: You can check your current leave balance at any time through the HR self-service portal under the Leave Management section. The portal shows balances for each leave type, leave history, pending requests, and upcoming approved leaves. Balances are updated in real-time.

instruction: What is the annual leave planning requirement?
output: Employees must submit their planned leave calendar for the year by January 31st to help managers ensure adequate team coverage. Changes to planned leave can be made with at least 2 weeks' notice subject to manager approval. This applies primarily to earned leave.

instruction: Is there moving day leave?
output: Yes, one day of moving day leave per year is provided for employees relocating their residence within the same city. This does not apply to inter-city relocations which are covered under the relocation policy. Apply at least 3 days in advance through the HR portal.

instruction: What is the compensation review timeline?
output: The annual compensation review begins in January with market data analysis. Manager recommendations are submitted in February, calibration occurs in March, and new compensation is communicated in the first week of April with retroactive effect from April 1st.

instruction: How is HRA calculated?
output: House Rent Allowance is calculated at 50% of basic salary for employees in metro city locations (Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad) and 40% of basic salary for non-metro locations. HRA exemption is available subject to tax rules.

instruction: What is the salary advance repayment schedule?
output: Salary advances are repaid over 6 months through automatic salary deduction in equal monthly installments. The deduction begins from the month following the advance disbursement. There is no interest charged on salary advances for eligible emergencies.

instruction: How does the flexible benefit plan allocation work?
output: You can allocate your CTC across various components during the annual enrollment window. Options include food coupons (up to INR 2,200/month), fuel allowance, telephone reimbursement, and professional development. Changes take effect from the month following your selection.

instruction: What are the tax benefits available for employees?
output: Tax benefits include HRA exemption, standard deduction of INR 50,000, Section 80C investments (up to INR 1,50,000), NPS contribution under 80CCD, health insurance premium under 80D, and education loan interest under 80E. The payroll team provides annual guidance on tax planning.

instruction: How is the performance bonus taxed?
output: Performance bonus is taxed as regular income in the year of receipt. TDS is deducted at the applicable slab rate when the bonus is paid. The bonus amount is included in Form 16 for the relevant financial year. Consult the payroll team for advance tax planning.

instruction: What happens to my salary during leave without pay?
output: During leave without pay, salary is deducted proportionally for the number of LWP days. PF contribution is calculated on the reduced salary. Extended LWP may also affect bonus eligibility and annual increment calculations. Health insurance coverage continues during short LWP periods.

instruction: Is there a retention bonus?
output: Retention bonuses may be offered to critical talent during organizational transitions, restructuring, or when key projects require continuity. The amount and terms are determined case-by-case by the department head and HR. Retention bonuses typically come with a service commitment clause.

instruction: What is covered under group health insurance?
output: Coverage includes hospitalization, day care procedures, pre and post-hospitalization expenses (30 and 60 days respectively), ambulance charges, domiciliary treatment, maternity expenses, and newborn baby coverage. Room rent is covered up to single private AC room. Network hospitals offer cashless treatment.

instruction: How do I add dependents to my health insurance?
output: Dependents (spouse, up to 2 children, and dependent parents) can be added during the annual enrollment window in January. New additions due to marriage or childbirth can be made within 30 days of the event. Submit supporting documents through the benefits portal.

instruction: What is the personal accident insurance coverage?
output: Group personal accident insurance provides 24-hour worldwide coverage. The sum insured is 5 times your annual basic salary. It covers accidental death, permanent total disability, permanent partial disability, and temporary total disability. Additional voluntary cover is available at subsidized rates.

instruction: How do I claim health insurance reimbursement?
output: For reimbursement claims, submit the claim form along with original hospital bills, discharge summary, prescription, and investigation reports within 30 days of discharge. Claims are processed by the TPA within 15-20 working days. Use network hospitals for cashless facility.

instruction: Is mental health treatment covered under insurance?
output: Yes, mental health treatment is covered under the group health insurance policy as mandated by regulations. Coverage includes psychiatric consultations, therapy sessions, and hospitalization for mental health conditions. The EAP also provides 6 free counseling sessions per year.

instruction: What wellness programs are available?
output: Wellness programs include annual health screenings, vaccination drives, mental health awareness sessions, yoga classes, meditation workshops, nutrition counseling, fitness challenges, and steps competitions. The wellness committee organizes monthly activities. All programs are free and voluntary.

instruction: How do I access the Employee Assistance Program?
output: Access the EAP by calling the helpline number (available 24/7), emailing the EAP partner, or scheduling through the benefits portal. Services are completely confidential - no information is shared with the company. You get 6 free sessions per year covering personal and professional concerns.

instruction: What retirement benefits are available?
output: Retirement benefits include Employee Provident Fund (12% employer + 12% employee contribution of basic), gratuity after 5 years of service, and National Pension Scheme (optional). Pre-retirement counseling and financial planning support are provided to employees within 5 years of retirement.

instruction: How do I set my performance goals?
output: Performance goals are set in April each year through a collaborative discussion with your manager. Goals should be SMART (Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, Time-bound) and aligned with team and organizational objectives. Typically 4-6 goals are set for the year.

instruction: What is the mid-year review process?
output: The mid-year review in October is a checkpoint to assess progress on your annual goals, identify challenges, and make adjustments if needed. It's not a formal rating exercise but provides documented feedback. Both self-assessment and manager feedback are captured in the system.

instruction: How do I prepare for my annual performance review?
output: Complete your self-assessment highlighting achievements, goal progress, challenges overcome, and development activities. Gather evidence of impact and contributions. Request peer feedback if applicable. Review your goals from the beginning of the year and document specific outcomes and metrics.

instruction: What is 360-degree feedback?
output: 360-degree feedback collects input from multiple sources including your manager, peers, direct reports (if applicable), and cross-functional stakeholders. It's used primarily for leadership development rather than performance rating. Results are shared confidentially with you for development planning.

instruction: How do I request a role change within the company?
output: Browse open positions on the internal job posting portal. You must have completed 12 months in your current role to apply. Discuss your career interests with your manager during career conversations. The talent marketplace also shows project-based opportunities for skill development.

instruction: What career development resources are available?
output: Resources include individual development plans, mentorship programs, coaching pool, online learning library (10,000+ courses), tuition reimbursement, conference attendance, job rotation programs, cross-functional projects, and leadership development programs. Discuss options with your manager.

instruction: How are promotions communicated?
output: Promotions are communicated by your manager in a private conversation first, followed by a formal letter from HR. The promotion is effective from April 1st. Revised compensation details are shared in the annual increment letter. A public announcement is made with your consent.

instruction: What is the leadership development program?
output: The program identifies high-potential employees for accelerated growth into leadership roles. It includes classroom learning, action learning projects, executive coaching, board exposure, and international assignments. Participants commit to a 3-year service agreement upon completion.

instruction: What is the substance abuse policy?
output: The company has a zero-tolerance policy for substance abuse in the workplace. Employees found under the influence of alcohol or controlled substances during work hours face immediate suspension pending investigation. Confidential rehabilitation support is available through the EAP.

instruction: What is the intellectual property policy?
output: Intellectual property created during employment belongs to the company, including inventions, designs, software code, and documentation. You must disclose any inventions to the IP committee. Prior inventions should be declared at joining to exclude them. The company supports patent filing for innovations.

instruction: What is the document retention policy?
output: Employee records are maintained for 8 years after separation. Financial records are retained for 10 years. Recruitment records for unsuccessful candidates are kept for 2 years. All document disposal follows approved destruction procedures. Electronic records are backed up daily.

instruction: What is the acceptable use policy for IT equipment?
output: Personal use of company equipment should be minimal and not interfere with work duties. All data on company devices is subject to monitoring and audit. Do not install unauthorized software. Use only approved cloud storage. Report any suspicious activity or potential security breach immediately.

instruction: What is the workplace photography and recording policy?
output: Photography and recording in the workplace require prior approval from facility management. Recording meetings without consent of all participants is prohibited. Client-sensitive areas have strict no-photography policies. Social media posting of office content requires communications team approval.

instruction: What is the company's stance on workplace bullying?
output: Workplace bullying including persistent criticism, isolation, excessive monitoring, impossible deadlines, or undermining behavior is strictly prohibited. Report bullying to your HR business partner or through the anonymous feedback system. All reports are investigated and appropriate action taken.

instruction: How does the company handle data breaches?
output: Report suspected data breaches immediately to the IT security team at the designated emergency contact. Do not attempt to investigate or contain the breach yourself. The incident response team assesses, contains, and resolves the breach. Affected parties are notified as per regulatory requirements.

instruction: What is the business continuity plan?
output: The BCP outlines procedures for maintaining operations during disruptions including natural disasters, IT failures, and health emergencies. All critical roles have backup personnel. Annual BCP drills test readiness. You should know your role in the BCP and your designated assembly point.

instruction: I want to pursue an MBA while working. What support is available?
output: The company supports higher education through flexible scheduling, examination leave (10 days/year), and tuition reimbursement (up to INR 2,00,000/year). The course must be relevant to your role or career path. Discuss with your manager first, then apply through the L&D portal. A 2-year service bond applies.

instruction: I'm getting married. What leaves and benefits changes do I need to make?
output: You can take casual leave or earned leave for your wedding. Update your marital status, add your spouse to health insurance within 30 days of marriage through the benefits portal. Update your nominee details for PF, gratuity, and life insurance. Submit marriage certificate to HR for records.

instruction: I'm expecting a baby. What are the steps I should follow?
output: Female employees: Inform HR and your manager, plan maternity leave (26 weeks available). Male employees: Plan paternity leave (10 days within 30 days of birth). Both: Add newborn to health insurance within 30 days of birth, update nominee details, explore creche/daycare benefits.

instruction: I received a job offer from another company. What should I know about my exit?
output: Submit resignation through the HR portal. Your notice period is 60 days (90 for directors). You must complete knowledge transfer, return all assets, and finish exit clearance. Full settlement within 45 days of last working day. Non-compete clause applies for 12 months for managers and above.

instruction: I'm being transferred to another city. What relocation support do I get?
output: Relocation benefits include moving expenses up to INR 1,00,000, temporary accommodation for 30 days, settling-in allowance of INR 50,000, and one day moving leave. Family relocation benefits are available for manager level and above. Submit relocation claims within 30 days of moving.

instruction: I want to report my manager for unfair treatment. What are my options?
output: You have several options: speak directly with your HR business partner, file a grievance through the HR portal, use the anonymous feedback system, contact the ethics helpline (24/7), or request a skip-level meeting. All reports are handled confidentially with a no-retaliation guarantee.

instruction: I accidentally shared confidential data. What should I do?
output: Report the incident immediately to the IT security team - do not delay. Provide details of what was shared, with whom, and through which channel. The incident response team will assess the risk and take containment measures. Self-reporting demonstrates good faith and is considered during any investigation.

instruction: Can I work from a different country for a few weeks?
output: International remote work for extended periods requires prior approval from HR and legal teams due to tax, visa, and compliance implications. Short periods (under 2 weeks) during personal travel may be possible with manager approval. Inform payroll of your location for tax compliance.

instruction: I have a side project/startup idea. Is that allowed?
output: Outside business interests require prior written approval from HR. They must not conflict with your duties, use company resources, or compete with company business. Submit a disclosure form to the compliance team. If approved, it's documented and reviewed annually. Non-disclosure is a policy violation.

instruction: How do I handle a conflict with a colleague?
output: Start with a direct, professional conversation with your colleague to understand perspectives and find common ground. If unresolved, involve your manager for mediation. For formal resolution, contact your HR business partner. The conflict resolution process includes mediation, investigation if needed, and final decision.

instruction: I'm not happy with my performance rating. Can I appeal?
output: Discuss your concerns with your manager first, providing specific examples and evidence. If unresolved, escalate to your HR business partner who can facilitate a discussion or arrange a skip-level meeting. The calibration process ensures fairness, but legitimate concerns are reviewed seriously.

instruction: What should I do if I witness harassment of another employee?
output: Report what you witnessed to the ICC through the confidential portal, email, or in person. You can also use the ethics helpline anonymously. As a witness, you're protected by the no-retaliation policy. Your cooperation in any investigation is important for ensuring a safe workplace for all.

instruction: I need time off for a religious observance not on the holiday list. What do I do?
output: You can use one of your 2 restricted holidays if available, or apply for casual leave. The company's dress code exemption process also handles religious accommodation requests. Discuss with your manager for any schedule adjustments needed. The company respects all religious observances.

instruction: I'm returning from maternity leave. What support is available?
output: The return-to-work program includes a phased return option, updated role briefing, dedicated HR support during your first month, and creche/daycare facilities. Discuss flexible work arrangements with your manager. Your role and level are protected - you should return to an equivalent position.

instruction: How do I nominate a colleague for a spot award?
output: Discuss the nomination with your manager (or submit directly if you are a manager). Provide specific details of the exceptional contribution through the recognition platform. Department head approval is needed. Awards range from INR 5,000 to 25,000. Recognition is public and announced in team meetings.

instruction: I'm interested in volunteering. What options are available?
output: You get 2 paid volunteering days per year for company-organized CSR activities. Programs include teaching at underprivileged schools, environmental drives, and community health camps. Monthly activities are organized by the CSR committee. Sign up through the CSR portal on the intranet.

instruction: How do I escalate an unresolved HR query?
output: The escalation matrix goes from HR helpdesk to HR business partner, then department head, HR director, and finally the Chief People Officer. Response timelines are defined at each level. If the standard process hasn't resolved your concern, you can formally escalate citing the previous attempts.

instruction: What happens if I fail the probation review?
output: If performance during probation is below expectations, the probation period may be extended by up to 3 months with a clear improvement plan. If improvement is insufficient after extension, employment may be terminated with applicable notice. The decision involves your manager and HR.

instruction: I've been asked to travel on a public holiday. What compensation do I get?
output: Working on a public holiday entitles you to compensatory off within 30 days plus applicable overtime compensation (2x hourly rate). Travel time on a public holiday is counted as work time. Submit the comp-off request through the HR system with your manager's approval.

instruction: How do I update my bank account for salary?
output: Update your bank details through the HR self-service portal under Personal Information. A cancelled cheque or bank statement must be uploaded for verification. HR will verify the change before processing. The update takes effect from the next payroll cycle. Allow 5 working days for processing.

instruction: What is the process for reporting workplace safety concerns?
output: Report safety hazards through the workplace incident reporting system on the intranet, directly to facility management, or to your floor safety warden. For immediate dangers, contact security at extension 100. All reports are investigated within 24 hours. You can report anonymously if preferred.

instruction: Can I request a standing desk?
output: Yes, standing desk converters are available upon request through the facility management portal. You can also request a full standing desk if recommended by the ergonomic assessment. Submit a request citing any discomfort. Equipment is provided within 10 working days of approval.

instruction: What is the policy on company car or vehicle allowance?
output: The vehicle policy applies to senior manager level and above. Options include a car lease (covering maintenance, insurance, and fuel up to limits) or a fixed monthly car allowance added to salary. Choose during your compensation structuring. The policy document details limits by level.

instruction: How do I submit investment proofs for tax savings?
output: Submit investment proofs by January 31st through the HR self-service portal. Upload scanned copies of investment receipts, insurance premium receipts, home loan statements, rent receipts, and other relevant documents. The payroll team verifies and adjusts TDS from February salary onwards.

instruction: What is the company's policy on working beyond 48 hours per week?
output: Overtime exceeding 48 hours per week requires special approval from the HR director and must comply with labor regulations. The company monitors overtime patterns to ensure well-being. Departments with consistently high overtime must submit staffing justification reports. Your health comes first.

instruction: How does the company support employees with chronic health conditions?
